ethernet.vendor_role_note: Vendor documentation describes one WAN and two LAN ports; current product material also describes one LAN port as WAN/LAN switchable for dual-WAN operation.

evidence.supports: CPU class and frequency, memory/storage capacity, three 2.5GbE ports, USB 3.0, power, and vendor firmware family.
Brume 3 model identity, Cortex-A53 CPU family, 1 GB RAM, 8 GB eMMC, and OpenWrt 21.02 vendor software baseline.
GL.iNet documents a U-Boot Web UI recovery flow for GL-MT5000 and the model-specific LED entry sequence. GoreeCloud direct recovery verification is still required.
evidence.status: source-reported; not directly verified by GoreeCloud

evidence.supports: GLiNet-Tech's vendor-authored OpenWrt submission reports MT7987A, RTL8366ub LAN-switch topology, UART parameters, an eMMC flash layout, and an OpenWrt sysupgrade path.
evidence.status: closed unmerged; useful vendor implementation evidence but not accepted upstream support

unknowns: Direct target confirmation of the vendor-reported MediaTek MT7987A SoC identifier.
Boot ROM and bootloader chain, signing behavior, and writable boot-environment boundaries.
Direct target verification of the vendor-documented U-Boot recovery path on the actual hardware revision.
Direct target verification of the vendor-reported eMMC/GPT partition layout and boot-critical partition ownership before any write.
Linux device-tree compatibility and board identifier for the selected GoreeCloud kernel.
Linux interface names and physical-port-to-netdev mapping.
Direct target verification of the vendor-reported Realtek RTL8366ub / SoC Ethernet topology and hardware offload behavior.
Direct target confirmation of the vendor-reported UART and a safe console-access procedure.
Hardware watchdog availability and reset semantics.
Thermal sensor exposure and safe operating thresholds.
Accepted upstream/mainline kernel support level for all required board peripherals; the reviewed OpenWrt proposal was closed unmerged.
Safe installation and rollback procedure that preserves a recoverable vendor or GoreeCloud boot path.

recovery.entry_behavior: Hold Reset while powering on; GL.iNet documents the GL-MT5000 Power LED flashing blue 7 times and then turning solid white before the recovery Web UI flow.

openwrt_submission.status: vendor-authored upstream implementation proposal; OpenWrt PR #21728 closed unmerged
openwrt_submission.installation_note: The vendor-authored proposal describes sysupgrade from GL.iNet firmware, but this is not a GoreeCloud installation authorization and the upstream proposal was not merged.
